mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO pos_special_item (special_id, material_id, special_price, discount_rate, limit_qty, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.specialId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.specialPrice}, #{i.discountRate}, #{i.limitQty}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.retail_price FROM pos_special_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.special_id = #{specialId} ORDER BY i.id
